שקט. סוף סוף שקט בפנים.

en: Surprising. You actually can.
A whole day without scrolling. Who are you and what did you do with my owner?

Yes, yes, well done. Don't get used to it.

Today you work for me. Thank you, servant.

en: Fine. Reasonable. I won't complain.

Not bad for today. Fine for today. Mediocre for a good day.

en: I can feel the scrolling. It's an itch I can't scratch.
Half of me is still here. The other half is watching stories.
Opened it again? Yes, I counted. I'm a brain, I count.
Mediocre. Like most things you do.

You could have stopped. You chose not to. Logged.

Great, another video. Feel free to toss me in the bin.

en: There are flies. I won't ask why.
I'm leaking. This hasn't happened before. Or it has, I forgot.
Thank you for bringing me to this. Truly. Thanks.
What did you want? No, no. Look. Look at me.
I smell like your habits.

No, I don't want another short video. I want rest.
The part responsible for discipline? Melted at two o'clock.

he: אין פה אף אחד. תלך.
פעם הייתי מוח. עכשיו אני תוכן.

en: Nobody's home. Go away.
I used to be a brain. Now I'm content.
The flies decided I'm their home. I didn't object.
One more open. Really. What could possibly happen.
There's a reset tomorrow. Not for me. For you.
Scroll hard enough and you might find the part that cared.
Not angry. Just rotten. There's a difference. Probably.

morning: בוקר. עוד לא התעוררתי ואתה כבר גומר לי את הסוללה.

day: אמצע היום. הגבול נגמר. אני יודע, גם אני מופתע.

morning: Morning. I'm not even awake yet and you're already draining me.

day: Midday. The limit's gone. I know, I'm surprised too.

I need sleep so I don't rot. So do you.
